subtitle: Per-user facts the agent has accumulated. Long-term memory that survives session resets.

noUserSelected.title: Pick a user to view their memory
noUserSelected.description: Memory is partitioned per user_key (platform:userId). The dropdown above lists every user whose memory has any rows in the bank.

empty.title: No facts yet
empty.description: Facts accumulate as the agent extracts them from chat history during memory consolidation. Triggering `/memory consolidate` from chat (or the Persona tab's button when it lands) seeds this list.

batch.confirmDeleteDesc: This removes the rows from the bank. The vector index keeps any embedding derived from these rows until the next backfill prune.

action.confirmDeleteDesc: This row is removed permanently. The vector index retains its embedding until the next backfill prune.

persona.title: Persona
persona.subtitle: Long-form summary of who this user is, refined by periodic consolidation of their facts.

empty.title: No persona yet
empty.description: Personas are written by the consolidation pass — run it from the button below once enough facts have accumulated.

persona.confirmDeleteDesc: The persona summary is removed from the bank. Facts the persona was derived from stay in place; the next consolidate pass will rewrite a fresh one.

distill.title: Dream distillation
distill.subtitle: Chat turns are buffered, then batch-extracted into facts in the background when the system is idle — or once a user's oldest turn passes the staleness floor. Configure the extraction model + cadence, watch the buffer, or force a pass now.

form.title: Configuration
form.hint: Pick which model extracts facts, then tune the schedule. Changes hit the env file and reload in-process; a restart re-reads them.
form.sourceHelp: Which LLM turns buffered chat into facts.
form.autoNote: Zero-config: each batch is extracted by the agent that handled those turns. Recommended for most installs.
form.agentHelp: Use this enabled agent CLI for every extraction, regardless of which agent handled the turn.
form.noAgents: No agents enabled. Enable one under Settings → Agents first.
form.llmBackendHelp: Bind a configured LLM backend to the `distill` role — a direct API call, no CLI spawn. Manage backends under Settings → LLM.
form.noBackends: No LLM backends configured. Add one under Settings → LLM first.
form.enabledHelp: Master switch for the background pass. When off, turns still buffer but are never extracted.
form.intervalMsHelp: How often the background pass wakes up. Default 300000 (5 min); minimum 10000.
form.floorMinHelp: On a continuously-busy bot, force-flush a user once their oldest buffered turn is this old. Default 30.
form.batchMaxHelp: Max turns fed to one extraction call. Default 20.
form.maxPendingHelp: Max buffered turns kept per user before the oldest are dropped. Default 200.

errors.agentRequired: Pick an agent for the agent source
errors.llmRequired: Pick an LLM backend for the LLM source

status.title: Status
status.bufferEmpty: Buffer is empty — all turns have been distilled.

vector.title: Vector backend
vector.subtitle: Embeddings power hybrid recall on memory facts. The active backend, model, and per-user coverage live here.

config.title: Backend configuration
config.hint: Backend selection + OpenAI / local-model parameters live in env. Edit `~/.agim/env` on the host (or set systemd `Environment=`); the `AGIM_MEMORY_VECTOR_*` keys are listed below.

form.title: Backend configuration
form.hint: Pick a backend, fill in the parameters, then save & test. Changes hit the env file and reload in-process; a restart re-reads them.
form.backendHelp: off = vector recall disabled; local = on-device BGE; openai = OpenAI-compatible remote endpoint
form.localModelHelp: Xenova model id, defaults to Xenova/bge-base-zh-v1.5. First-time use needs a manual download.
form.openaiBaseUrlHelp: OpenAI-compatible endpoint root, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or your self-hosted gateway.
form.openaiModelHelp: Embedding model id, defaults to text-embedding-3-small. Match your provider's docs for other endpoints.
form.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the existing key (placeholder shows the masked value); typing replaces it.
form.apiKeyNewHint: Paste your OpenAI-compatible API key (only the server sees the raw value after save).
form.hybridWeightHelp: Vector branch weight when fusing with FTS5 recall, 0–1 (default 0.5).

errors.baseUrlInvalid: Base URL is not a valid URL
errors.apiKeyRequired: API key is required for the OpenAI backend on first setup
errors.batchSizeRange: Batch size must be between 1 and 1024
errors.hybridWeightRange: Hybrid weight must be between 0 and 1

actions.title: Maintenance
actions.backfillNotReady: Backend not ready — run download first
actions.confirmClearDesc: Drops the embedding column for {{scope}}. Facts themselves stay; you'll need to backfill again before vector recall works.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: SKILL.md files the host agents pick up from ~/.claude/skills/ + ~/.config/opencode/skills/.

empty.title: No skills installed
empty.description: Drop a SKILL.md (with `name` and `description` frontmatter) under one of the configured roots and refresh.
